mapper.insert: insert into mq_dead_letter(message_id, business_message_id, queue, payload, state, retry_count, consume_fail_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{messageId}, #{businessMessageId}, #{queue}, #{payload}, 'pending', 0, 0, now(), now())
mapper.update: update mq_dead_letter set state = 'replayed', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'reviewed'

update mq_dead_letter set retry_count = retry_count + 1, state = case when retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} then 'manual_pending' else 'reviewed' end, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and state = 'reviewed'
update mq_dead_letter set state = 'manual_pending', update_time = now() where id = #{id}

update mq_dead_letter m inner join ( select max(id) as id from mq_dead_letter where business_message_id = #{businessMessageId} and state = 'replayed' ) t on m.id = t.id set m.consume_fail_count = m.consume_fail_count + 1, m.state = case when m.consume_fail_count + 1 >= #{maxConsumeFailures} then 'manual_pending' else 'pending' end, m.retry_count = case when m.consume_fail_count + 1 >= #{maxConsumeFailures} then m.retry_count else 0 end, m.update_time = now()
mapper.select: select id, message_id, business_message_id, queue, payload, state, retry_count, consume_fail_count from mq_dead_letter where business_message_id = #{businessMessageId} order by id desc limit 1
select count(1) from mq_dead_letter where state = #{state}
